review.purpose: Confirm that both chosen exchange codes are supported before asking for their schedules.
review.finding: The discovery relation supplies XLON and XNYS, materialized as selected_exchanges. The next SQL guard requires both unique codes before schedule retrieval; support for a code does not assert coverage or an open session on a date.

review.purpose: Intersect modeled London and New York sessions using actual UTC boundaries over a fixed three-week window.
review.finding: The selected default week has five joint sessions and ten shared hours; the later week has fifteen shared hours while individual session lengths remain 6.5/8.5 hours. Both schedules are retrieved once and reused; covered closed dates remain on the date spine and no live trading activity is inferred.

review.purpose: Distinguish a closed date from missing calendar coverage before assigning zero overlap.
review.finding: All 21 reference dates are covered, with six closed weekend dates and fifteen joint-session dates. Separate controls return true for a Monday, false for Saturday and NULL for 1900-01-01. Missing schedule rows alone cannot distinguish closure from unknown coverage.

review.purpose: Compare a covered-session opening instant with dates that have no opening timestamp.
review.finding: The 2026-10-19 New York control opens at 13:30 UTC, matching the materialized schedule. Saturday and the out-of-window 1900 date both have NULL openings but different session flags. An absent timestamp is not enough to establish closure; session dates and UTC instants are different quantities.

review.purpose: Retain an actual timezone-aware closing instant and distinguish its absence from a closed-session assertion.
review.finding: The covered Monday closes at 20:00 UTC and matches the schedule, while closed and uncovered dates have no closing timestamp. Invented events at the shared open and close verify half-open time membership; an exact closing instant is outside the modeled interval.

review.purpose: Reconcile half-open date counts with inclusive schedule endpoints without confusing counts and duration.
review.finding: The half-open range 19 October–9 November contains fifteen New York sessions, equal to schedule rows through 8 November inclusive. The exclusive endpoint does not add the 9 November session; this count is not the shared time or a settlement guarantee.
